notes.title: My new Game release!
notes.content:
The last ~ year I've been working on a game - Tooru!
Now you can play the fruit of my work - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1547350/Toru/?beta=0

Toru is a bullet-hell platformer where absolutely everything that falls into your hands becomes a weapon! Boxes, crystals, bombs and even the enemies themselves! Your success depends only on your skill!

notes.title: New boss!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ifGzaM7M3dtB3u1x6O/giphy.gif[/img]

Laura is a reinforced version of the first enemy - "Taran", whose name is Senior. Its plate is so strong that it makes no sense to hit it; you can attack it only after a powerful jerk into the wall.

notes.title: Update Demo 1.1
notes.content:
It was fixed:
- Animation bug with dialog state
- Collision bugs
- Bugs with the interface
- A bug with throwing enemies into the sky
- Bug with a metal wall
- A bug with a bullet collision
- Bug with optimization in the main menu
It was added:
- Options menu
- Graphics settings
- Screen resolution setting
- Auto save now happens more often
- Pointer for the first secret in the second level

notes.title: Demo!
notes.content:
Today uploaded to the Diesel Punch demo in open access)
It has 3 levels, mainly with training in basic mechanics and exposure to the plot.
I would be very grateful if you play and leave feedback!
Play here - https://vaddim.itch.io/diesel-punch
